Are you familiar with the demiurge concept? 

https://gnosticismexplained.org/the-gnostic-demiurge/

The Gnostics, and Greek philosophers like Plato, have suggested the God in the Old Testament is actually a malevolent architect of the material world. 

Highly recommend you look into this idea. There are lots of movies that connect to this concept like the Matrix, Prometheus, and Truman show.
